data.one_liner: Official Flutter plugin for integrating the PhotoEditor SDK into iOS and Android apps.
data.what_it_does: It allows developers to embed a fully-featured photo editor into their iOS and Android applications. It supports tools like cropping, filtering, text, stickers, and frame additions through native SDK wrappers.
use_when: You need a comprehensive photo editing suite with tools like filters, cropping, and text overlays in your app.
You are willing to use a commercial SDK (requires a commercial license for monetized apps).
avoid_when: You are building a free/open-source app without a commercial budget and cannot pay for the commercial PhotoEditor SDK license.
You only need basic image picking or simple cropping without heavy photo manipulation UI.
strengths: Provides a complete, production-ready photo editing interface.
Supports a wide array of editing modules (text, focus, frame, brush, filter, sticker, etc.).
Cross-platform support for both iOS and Android.
weaknesses: Requires a commercial license for monetized applications.
Involves detailed native configuration steps on Android (Gradle changes, repository additions).
Large binary size impacts due to included modules and asset packs.
data.setup_notes: Requires adding the IMG.LY repository to android/build.gradle, setting up minSdk 21 and compileSdkVersion 35, configuring native modules, and placing platform-specific license files in the assets directory.

alternatives.name: image_picker
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you only need to pick images from the gallery or camera without complex in-app editing features.
